records.confirmed_scope: The official Alþingi broadcast guide designates this YouTube channel for proceedings. A selected historical 2023 economic and trade committee hearing concerning competition law shows substantive committee speech and advances at 1202.81 seconds in Chromium. The title says 9 October 2023, while the camera overlay says 10.10.2023; no exact EPG date or current/live coverage is claimed. A challenge on the institution’s own site remains a separate access limitation. Evidence: reports/discovery/2026-10-25-continued-national-viewing-validation.json

The Parliament’s own Galerie video route redirects to this exact institutional YouTube channel. The 22 October 2026 plenary decodes substantive presiding-dais speech and advances at 1202.82 seconds in Chromium (1280 × 720 pixels). Committee entries are visible, but the selected committee test was interrupted before substantive playback. Current live coverage, coverage of every room, audible tracks and accessibility remain unverified. Evidence: reports/discovery/2026-10-25-continued-national-viewing-validation.json

The owned Chamber homepage designates its own Canal Parlamentario and the exact official YouTube handle. Its archive-labelled 15th and 14th ordinary-session videos both decode and advance beyond 1800 seconds in Chromium and WebKit. Inspected frames show a member discussing an expropriation bill at the chamber desk and the presiding chair conducting House business. TV wrapper dates are publication metadata: the main House news index dates its 15th sitting differently, so exact occurrence dates remain unreconciled.

Normal HTTPS now returns the owned Chamber homepage, which designates @dipusanluis and links the archived 28th ordinary session of 21 October 2026. Chromium decodes and advances beyond 1800 seconds. The inspected frame shows Silvia Sosa Araújo at the House dais, matching chamber branding, named lower third and on-video 21 October timestamp. This is one recorded sitting, not current-live or complete service validation; no WebKit playback is asserted for this new sample.

The owned Senate homepage designates its ordinary Senate video channel, separate from the Constituent Convention channel. Its 15 October 2026 report of the 27th ordinary sitting directly embeds the Alejandra Navarro municipal-charter and Juan Cruz Curá C14/C15 railway speeches. Both source clips decode and advance from 30 to 31 seconds in process-muted Chromium; inspected images show actual chamber-floor debate and a senator addressing the chamber. These are two short segments of one sitting, not two meeting dates or full-session validation.

The first link is a planned 29 October sitting, not observed current live.

The owned parliament homepage directly designates this exact channel. Selected 20 October 2026 Sports and Childhood committee-speaker recordings were confirmed in both engines. These are committee recordings, not an assertion of complete plenary/live coverage. The parliament represents the French Community across Wallonia and Brussels; its Brussels map marker is an institutional location, not a jurisdiction outline.

The owned assembly archive embeds the 12 October 2026 sitting. Both engines decode and advance beyond twenty minutes. Only one sitting date was sampled; current live and complete committee coverage remain unverified. The source anonymizes portions of its own recordings under its publication rules.
